div.div:
Mental model
Task format is the packaging layer. Job and TrialQueue are the scaling layer. Agent and Environment are independent plugins. Verifier and artifacts are the evidence layer. Registry, Hub, Viewer, and Leaderboard are distribution and review surfaces.
